race.comment: HELL OR HEAVEN (11) is the top pick on juvenile form that reads well for this, notably a fourth in a 2YO Open at Ipswich on heavy ground, and a close second there the run prior. Has been fitted with a solid trial at Deagon and is drawn to get all the favours. Bold showing anticipated. SPEEDY CROWN (4) has been close in both runs this campaign, finishing fifth at Doomben last week after a sound Ipswich fourth. Looks ready to peak third-up and gets in well with 2kg claim. Genuine threat. FINAL CRUSADE (10) also has the right profile fresh. He was last sighted finishing midfield in a million dollar Gold Coast 2YO race, taken out by the talented The Next Episode. Fitted with a trial and gets the key booking of Thompson. Have to take seriously. ANDERLAY (6) showed good signs on debut at Ipswich, only conceding late after leading them up. With natural second-up improvement and under a featherweight, she could prove tough to reel in if left alone in front.
